=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:580-709 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: If the Actions-runs lookup fails, `_pr_head_ci_runs_pending` treats the unreadable result as zero pending runs, allowing `_pr_wait_for_required_checks` to succeed when check-runs are otherwise `ok` and no named CI check is configured.
  WHY: With CI queued and its check-runs not yet registered, an Actions-runs API failure can let the noop-suspicious force-merge gate reach `gh pr merge` without determining whether CI is pending.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The noop-suspicious force-merge Gate D must use the shared `_pr_wait_for_required_checks` helper with the head SHA, skip the PR when any required check is still running, and pass `--match-head-commit "${N_HEAD_SHA}"` to the `gh pr merge` call so the merge only applies to the head the gates checked (issue #7126 finding `noop-gate-d-ignores-pending-checks-unbound-merge`).
  expected_change_site: `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` in the noop-suspicious force-merge Gate D block (lines ~28150-28390).
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: present. The LAST RUN DIFF replaces `_pr_checks_completed "${N_PR}" "${N_HEAD_SHA}" "${N_BASE_REF}"` with `_pr_wait_for_required_checks "${N_PR}" "${N_HEAD_SHA}" "${N_BASE_REF}" 0` (line ~28297), adds the missing-helper fail-closed guard (`command -v _pr_wait_for_required_checks`), handles `timeout`/`query_failed`/`unresolved_head_sha` without paging, and binds the merge with `--match-head-commit "${N_HEAD_SHA}"` (line ~28385). Each is exercised by tests `test_sweep_force_merge_gate_d_uses_shared_checks_gate`, `test_noop_pending_checks_wait_without_paging`, `test_noop_failed_checks_page_once`, `test_noop_no_check_runs_fails_closed`, `test_noop_all_gates_pass_merge_bound_to_head`. Addressed.
- requirement: Fork PRs must be excluded from the noop-suspicious force-merge fallback, noop warnings and the editor summary must count only when posted by the pipeline's own login, and a productive commit must carry the pipeline's git identity as author or committer (issue #7126 finding `noop-force-merge-forged-comment-gates`).
  expected_change_site: `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` noop-suspicious sweep loop (lines ~27500-28390) plus `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_noop_suspicious_recovery.py`.
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: present. The LAST RUN DIFF adds `isCrossRepository` and `headRepositoryOwner` to the `gh pr list --json` call, gates on `N_CROSS_REPO != "false"` or owner mismatch before any per-PR read (line ~27951), re-checks `.head.repo.full_name` against `GITHUB_REPOSITORY` on the live PR read (line ~28166), threads `N_TRUSTED_LOGIN` through the warning count, summary filter, and productive-commit filter with `NOOP_PRODUCTIVE_COMMIT_NAME`/`_EMAIL`. Covered by `test_noop_fork_pr_is_skipped_before_any_read`, `test_noop_head_owner_compare_is_case_insensitive`, `test_noop_untrusted_comments_drive_nothing`, `test_noop_untrusted_summary_fails_gate_b`, `test_noop_forged_productive_commit_fails_gate_c`, `test_noop_live_fork_head_skips`, `test_noop_unresolved_login_fails_closed`, `test_noop_productive_identity_matches_commit_writers`. Addressed.
- requirement: Every other poller merge site (`attempt_merge`, backward scan, ready-to-merge, review-blocked `merge` / final `fix` / no-fix paths, final integration merge) must pass `--match-head-commit` with the head its checks used and skip the tick when that SHA is missing.
  expected_change_site: `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` merge sites outside the noop sweep.
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: present. The LAST RUN DIFF adds `--match-head-commit "${...head_sha}"` to six additional merge sites (final integration merge at ~12491, standalone stall at ~19681, backward scan at ~22944, ready-to-merge at ~23647, review-blocked merge/force-merge/no-fix at ~24823/24887/25208), each with a pre-check `if [ -z "${...head_sha}" ] || [ "${...head_sha}" = "null" ]` that warns and skips the tick. Covered by `test_every_poller_merge_is_head_bound`. Addressed.
- requirement: The newest trusted noop warning must name the head being merged in its `review-autofix-failure:v1` marker, so the audited review belongs to that head; older-head waits without paging, missing-marker fails closed.
  expected_change_site: `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` noop-suspicious sweep, between Gate A_state and the shared-gate check.
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: present. The LAST RUN DIFF adds the `N_NOOP_WARNING_HEAD` extraction (line ~28296), a fail-closed alert at `B_head` for missing markers, and a silent skip when the warning names a different head. Covered by `test_noop_warning_for_other_head_waits_without_paging` and `test_noop_warning_without_head_marker_fails_closed`. Addressed.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:580-709 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When the Actions-runs lookup fails, `_pr_head_ci_runs_pending` normalizes the unreadable result to zero pending runs. For consumer repositories, the named CI check defaults to `none`, so `_pr_wait_for_required_checks` does not bind a named check or treat the unreadable run list as unknown. If check-runs otherwise report `ok`, it returns success.
  WHY: With CI queued and its check-runs not yet registered, an Actions-runs API failure lets the noop-suspicious force-merge gate reach `gh pr merge` despite being unable to determine whether CI is pending. The gate should not treat an unreadable pending-run check as evidence that no CI run is active.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
